card.name: Digits inside section numbers and decimals
card.fires_on: Mostly a single digit or decimal point inside a section reference or number, such as the 2 in 2.4 or the point in 63.6. It also fires on a few linking words like when, with and them.

modes.label: Section numbers and decimals
modes.description: A digit or point partway through a cross-reference number or a decimal value.

modes.label: Linking words in clauses
modes.description: Small words such as when, with or them that continue a clause.
modes.example: for workers<< when>> they change employers.

card.writes: The promoted tokens are scattered (molec, families, Chinese words), and the suppressed tokens are Chinese body terms, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It lights up on the middle of numbers such as section references and decimals, and sometimes on small linking words.
